summary: This extended-command case reaches the same missing function-name dispatch in js/cmd.js:doextcmd() as the other four v48 extended-command failures. C's cmd.c:doextcmd() invokes the selected extcmdlist function pointer; this row maps to do_fight(), but the JS switch falls through to its generic unsupported-command refusal. The handler exists. The selected #fight row also carries PREFIXCMD, so cmd.c:rhack() consumes the following movement command after do_fight() returns.

source.branch: The player selects the #fight extended command. Upstream cmd.c:doextcmd() invokes the selected extcmdlist function pointer and publishes that row through ge.ext_tlist. This row maps to do_fight() and carries PREFIXCMD; cmd.c:rhack() reads ge.ext_tlist after the handler returns, records the selected command, and then consumes the next command as the force-fight prefix. The JS switch had no do_fight arm, while its caller had no selected-row handoff.
callers: cmd.c:rhack dispatches '#' to doextcmd(); cmd.c:doextcmd invokes the selected do_fight function pointer and publishes the row through ge.ext_tlist (493-519). cmd.c:rhack consumes the published row, honors PREFIXCMD, and reads the next command (3748-3777).
js/cmd.js:rhack dispatches '#' to doextcmd(); js/cmd.js:doextcmd maps the selected ef_funct and returns its row through the callback; rhack uses the row flags for the prefix handoff.
dependencies: This row shares the missing doextcmd ef_funct mapping with #fire/dofire, #throw/dothrow, #close/doclose, and #wield/dowield; all five existing handlers are wired in one dispatcher repair.
Because #fight carries PREFIXCMD, the selected-row handoff through rhack is required to consume its following command. The repair does not claim that all doextcmd or rhack branches are ported.

evidence: The v48 baseline evaluation identifies synthetic/v48/v48-extended-fight-command-attempt1, with 2 unmatched screen(s), at step 33: unsupported hero command: do_fight() for the extended command 'fight' is not ported
Upstream cmd.c:doextcmd() invokes the selected ef_funct and stores its row in ge.ext_tlist; the #fight extcmdlist row has PREFIXCMD, which cmd.c:rhack() consumes at 3748-3777.

The JavaScript command module already implements do_fight and its ordinary key path handles fight prefixes. The missing behavior is the extended-command mapping and selected-row handoff, not a new do_fight implementation.
